description: From the Codex review of the commit that never silenced a runner shape and made a FAIL need a certain, immutable binding: a local `require` that is not Node's returns the project's own `it` (its `skip` still runs the test). `it` is destructured from a `require`, a declaration of the file, never a static import: TG003 warns that `it.skip` may skip `adds`, never FAIL. The real runner runs the test.
